## Benchmark boundary

- [ ] The official MazeBench engine, prompt, observations, and scoring remain unchanged; or the intervention is prominently recorded as a distinct experimental condition.
- [ ] No evaluator-private state or decoded identities are exposed to the model.
- [ ] No credentials, model weights, raw runs, reasoning traces, or machine-specific paths are included.
- [ ] Tests and documentation are updated where behavior changed.
